---
title: "Billboard Hot 100"
format: html
execute: 
 echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```


```{r}
billboard |>
 select(artist, track, date.entered, wk1:wk4)

summary(billboard$date.entered)

ggplot(billboard, aes(x = wk1)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5) +
  labs(
    x = "Week 1 ranking",
    y = "Number of songs",
    subtitle = paste("Values used:", sum(!is.na(billboard$wk1)))
  )

billboard |>
  select(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "week", values_to = "ranking") |>
  summarize(
    present = sum(!is.na(ranking)),
    missing = sum(is.na(ranking)),
    .by = week
  )

billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(week = readr::parse_number(week))

billboard_long |>
  summarize(
    week = max(week),
    rank = rank[which.max(week)],
    .by = c(artist, track)
  ) |>
  filter(week == 20) |>
  summarize(
    songs = n(),
    ranked_below_50 = sum(rank > 50)
  )

song_summary <- billboard_long |>
  arrange(week) |>
  summarize(
    first_rank = first(rank),
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    total_weeks = n(),
    .by = c(artist, track)
  )

top_10_songs <- song_summary |>
  filter(best_rank <= 10)

notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  top_10_songs |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    slice_min(first_week_at_best, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(notable = "Fastest to number one"),
  top_10_songs |>
    filter(best_rank == 1) |>
    slice_max(first_week_at_best, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(notable = "Slowest to number one"),
  top_10_songs |>
    slice_max(total_weeks, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    mutate(notable = "Longest top-10 chart run")
) |>
  select(notable, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank, first_week_at_best, total_weeks)

notable_songs |>
  select(notable, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank, first_week_at_best, total_weeks)

top_10_trajectories <- billboard_long |>
  semi_join(top_10_songs, by = c("artist", "track")) |>
  left_join(
    notable_songs |>
      transmute(artist, track, highlight = paste(artist, track, sep = " - ")),
    by = c("artist", "track")
  )

ggplot(top_10_trajectories, aes(x = week, y = rank, group = interaction(artist, track))) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(top_10_trajectories, is.na(highlight)),
    color = "gray",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(top_10_trajectories, !is.na(highlight)),
    aes(color = highlight),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(x = "Week", y = "Chart ranking", color = "Notable songs")
```
